title: Full Manifest Run
description: Walk a shipment through its entire booking lifecycle: quote it, book it, attach its customs paperwork, and confirm every downstream read reflects exactly what was quoted and uploaded — nothing drifts along the way.
successCondition: POST /api/booking/quote for a chosen origin/destination/package returns a breakdown. POST /api/booking with that exact same body returns 201 with the shipment's priceCents, distanceKm, and currency matching the quote exactly. GET /api/booking/:id returns the identical shipment. POST /api/booking/:id/documents with a valid small PDF succeeds with 201, and GET /api/booking/:id/documents then lists exactly that one document with matching filename, mimeType, and sizeBytes. GET /api/booking (list) includes this shipment as the most recent (first) entry for that customer.
hints: Keep the exact same origin/destination/package JSON between the quote and booking calls — even a tiny lat/lng difference will make priceCents diverge and break the comparison.
sizeBytes in the document metadata should equal the exact byte length of the file you uploaded — verify against your test file's actual size, not an assumed value.
